subject: POC final readout scheduling & decision - Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@acme-health.com>, Carlos Rivera <crivera@acme-health.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: POC final readout scheduling & decision - Acme Health

Thanks for taking the time today - quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment going into the trial.

Key success criteria (from today's call):
- End-to-end latency under 500ms p50 for the primary inference route (clinical-note generation).
- >92% relevance on the 250-case evaluation set (criteria defined in attached workbook).
- No PII leakage in generated outputs; all redaction rules validated against sample corpus.
- Integration stability: API up-time >= 99% during test window.

POC plan (high level):
- Start date: Mon, Nov 30 (we'll provision dedicated trial capacity).
- Length: 2 weeks (Nov 30-12/11).
- Final readout + exec decision: propose week of Dec 14 (see scheduling options below).

Ownership (initial):
- Redwood: Marissa (trial coordination), Neha (runtime/config + observability), Marcus (exec readout).
- Acme: Carlos (product owner), Priya (tech lead / integration), Alicia (procurement & exec sponsor).

Attachments: POC-success-metrics.xlsx (baseline metrics + evaluation set), draft SOW (SOW-draft_v2.docx), POC evaluation plan (POC-eval-plan.pdf). Link to working drive folder: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1abcPOC-plan

Next steps I propose:
1) Acme confirms the success criteria above (or suggests edits) - please reply with any changes.
2) Priya to confirm integration window and any firewall/IP allowlisting needs by Nov 26.
3) Redwood to provision trial capacity and share test credentials by Nov 29.
4) We pick a 30-45m slot for the final readout/exec decision week of Dec 14 - Marcus to propose availability.

Thanks - I can update the SOW with the agreed timeline once we lock dates.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0143

From: Carlos Rivera <crivera@acme-health.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alicia Gomez <agomez@acme-health.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.sh@acme-health.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC final readout scheduling & decision - Acme Health

Thanks Marissa - good recap. Couple clarifications from our side:

- Success criteria look correct. For the relevance metric, can we include a secondary qualitative acceptance for edge-case summaries (10 flagged cases reviewed manually)?
- Priya is copied - she'll confirm integration availability. She flagged that we may need a short maintenance window (30m) to add allowlisted IPs; we can do that Nov 29 morning.
- Procurement: Alicia, FYI we will need a standard MSSA + SOW. If we move to production after the POC, procurement will need ~2 weeks for signature.

On the final readout: the exec sponsor (Alicia) and our Head of Product would like to join the decision meeting. If possible, we'd prefer Dec 15 morning ET.

Carlos
Carlos Rivera
Product Manager | Acme Health
crivera@acme-health.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Rivera <crivera@acme-health.com>, Alicia Gomez <agomez@acme-health.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.sh@acme-health.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC final readout scheduling & decision - Acme Health

Appreciate the quick responses. Good call on the qualitative edge-case review - we'll include 10 flagged cases for manual review as a secondary acceptance check.

Concrete evaluation plan (attached as POC-eval-plan.pdf):
Week 0 (pre-provision): Nov 26-29
- Redwood: provision trial cluster, provide test API keys, baseline benchmarks (Neha).
- Acme: complete allowlist configuration (Priya) and provide example data samples.

Week 1: Nov 30- Dec 4
- Run initial integration tests, collect latency and correctness telemetry.
- Run the 250-case automated evaluation.

Week 2: Dec 7- Dec 11
- Iterate on prompt templates and any model/config tuning.
- Manual review of 10 flagged edge cases.

Deliverables:
- POC results workbook (POC-success-metrics.xlsx) with p50/p95 latency, relevance score, redaction verification, uptime logs.
- Final readout slide deck (Redwood will draft; will share two days before readout).

Action items & owners:
- Priya: confirm firewall/IP allowlist & sample dataset by Nov 26.
- Neha: share provisioning plan + access by Nov 29.
- Marissa: schedule final readout for week of Dec 14 (propose slots).
- Alicia: confirm exec attendees for decision meeting.

I'll update the draft SOW with the confirmed timeline and attach to the drive once Priya confirms allowlist details.

Marissa

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@acme-health.com>, Carlos Rivera <crivera@acme-health.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.sh@acme-health.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC final readout scheduling & decision - Acme Health

Hi all - thanks Marissa and team. For the executive readout / go-no-go decision, I can make Dec 15 at 10:00am ET (60m) or Dec 16 at 11:00am ET (45m). Prefer 60m on Dec 15 so we have time for Q&A and procurement next steps.

Attendees (suggested):
- Acme: Alicia (exec sponsor), Head of Product, Priya (tech lead), Procurement rep
- Redwood: Marcus (SVP Ops), Marissa (AE), Neha (runtime lead), Solutions engineer (TBD)

Procurement note: once Acme confirms go-forward, we'll circulate a finalized SOW + MSSA for signature. We typically use DocuSign for the SOW; draft link will be shared in-thread ahead of the readout.

Proposed next step: Alicia, could you confirm whether Dec 15 10:00am ET works for your execs? If yes, Marissa - please book the calendar and I'll coordinate the internal materials.

Marcus

From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@acme-health.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Rivera <crivera@acme-health.com>, Priya Shah <priya.sh@acme-health.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC final readout scheduling & decision - Acme Health

Dec 15, 10:00am ET works for our execs. Please go ahead and book.

Procurement: I confirm Acme will be ready to review the MSSA + SOW in the readout. Carlos - I'll loop in our procurement lead once Marissa sends the finalized SOW. We expect ~2 weeks for internal approvals after review.

One more ask: can Redwood include an estimated monthly cost for the projected production capacity in the SOW (ballpark range)? That will help speed the procurement review.

Thanks - Alicia
